findings.detail: Whole new QA databases and named low roles/env/object roots are separate from the M fixture's per-row ownership. Names, role suffixes, template choices, three unique markers and every path are literal-admitted; all must be absent before first creation. No existing QA journal or resource is adopted. Whole resources/data are retained, including partial creation states; there is no reset/reseed/drop or backend termination.

Public Root execution admission must bind the exact plan, existing parent marker, stopped writers, completed M double zero, two exact original new-M full107 seed capture references/raw hashes/row digests and this exact SourceReady review. The code validates reviewedSources pins for plan/common/provision and source capsule inputs before opening any new-M private source/owner secret or PG connection.

Connections are literal allowlisted to the new M PG15 host127.0.0.1:20432/server15432 and exact postgres/M/three QA database names. Live current database/session user/version/port/isolated flag/timezone are checked. Only the new M owner-password and admitted new-M initial private facts are read with nofollow/private-mode/inode/stability checks; no old private or older PG instance is selected.

Both current M product tables must exactly match the complete initial seed logical-row digests, with existing parent marker intact. Source full107 rows and product/control ACLs are captured before. Every template must have zero current connections immediately before CREATE DATABASE; no terminate_backend is used. Actual clone product rows must equal the admitted source seed. Source M full107 rows and ACLs must still equal before after all creations.

Every QA role is LOGIN/NOINHERIT/NOSUPERUSER/NOCREATEDB/NOCREATEROLE/NOBYPASSRLS/NOREPLICATION, no memberships, bounded connections. Only its own QA CONNECT/TEMP and poms DML/sequence usage are granted; schema/database CREATE and both marker schemas remain inaccessible. Owner-only r2m_qa_control marker binds actual database, unique QA marker, template/parent marker/source row digest/plan. Each QA role is actually checked to have no protected M product-table privilege, with source M ACL unchanged. Existing PUBLIC CONNECT is explicitly not misrepresented as absence of connection permission or as a QA app grant.

QA password/env/object roots must be absent and stay within exact new-M QA namespace. New random password is private; four exact env lines change only QA database/user/password/object root, and original source env raw bytes are rechecked unchanged. Journal creation/update uses guarded private exclusive/atomic files and records actual OIDs/states; arbitrary database/env names are rejected.

C found source01 retained only the fixed public category and lost original PG/assert diagnostics. Final source02 first saves original name/message/stack/code into a unique new-M private QA failure file; journal/public failure stores only fixed category and private receipt metadata. It does not dump the environment/password object. Unknown/partial provisioning is preserved rather than silently cleaned or claimed ready.
